info.name: Kindergarten tour
info.description: Everything the API does, on a whole kindergarten. First fill an empty database: `npm run dev`, then `npm run seed` in another terminal. Run the folders in order, or the whole collection with the Runner; it can run again and again: what it creates it deletes, what it changes it puts back (it only publishes a new timetable each time).

item.name: Invoices and payments
item.description: Invoices of a month and paying them (EPIC-06, FR-014): a new kid of the parent on the annual plan is invoiced, the parent pays the year and the month in one payment, a repeated request with the same Idempotency-Key makes no second payment (NFR-11). Then the money report by cash (FR-017). At the end the kid is deleted; the paid invoices and the payment stay as history.
